description: Edits a handbook article as its Edit page does: title, content_md, category, tags, audience, bucket, is_published, exclude_from_suggestions. Send only the fields to change (sop_id from read entity sops); content_md replaces the whole body, so read the article in full (read sops with id) and send all of it with the change in place. Saving supersedes pending suggestions on it. Before adding anything to the handbook, search the sops read entity by the topic (search finds by meaning): when an article already covers it, put the new text into that article (edit_handbook_article with its full content_md, the new lines placed where they belong, or draft_handbook_edit) instead of a new one; create a new article only when none fits, and say which closest article you found and why it did not fit. Audience comes from the person's words: cleaner SOPs, cleaning standards or staff = cleaner; policies, office or VA = va; when the words do not say, ask in one line. Ask which place, in one line naming both, when two places fit the person's words equally well: two articles, or two training modules that both match (two new-hire modules are a tie whatever their status, draft or published); a place the person named outright is never a tie. The proposed change is the confirmation, so never ask "should I add this?" first. If the article is in a training module with quiz questions, say in your answer that its questions may need regenerating (generate_training_questions with regenerate). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
